test_cases.name: reset_defaults
test_cases.desc: After ESPI_RESET#, link is Single I/O, 20 MHz, CRC disabled.

test_cases.name: get_status
test_cases.desc: GET_STATUS returns 16-bit STATUS with correct FREE/AVAIL bits.

test_cases.name: config_negotiate
test_cases.desc: SET_CONFIGURATION sets 66 MHz + Quad; GET_CONFIGURATION reads it back.

test_cases.name: vwire_tunnel
test_cases.desc: PUT_VWIRE delivers a system-event index/data pair; slave reflects it.

test_cases.name: wait_state
test_cases.desc: Slave not ready inserts 0x0F WAIT_STATE bytes before response code.
